name: Insomnia
summary: Insomnia is Kong's API client for HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket requests. Essentials is free, with Git Sync for up to 3 users. Pro lists at $12 and Enterprise at $45 per user a month, and the page does not say whether those figures are annual or monthly.

facts.text: Insomnia environments exist at global, collection and folder level, and folder values take precedence over global base values.
Secret variables are encrypted with a vault key, while confidential variables only hide values in the interface and are stored in plain text.
The Inso CLI runs Insomnia tests from a terminal with an exit code, and can run in CI/CD. Legacy unit tests are hidden by default from version 13.3.
A collection can be built from scratch, from a pasted cURL command, or by importing Postman, OpenAPI, HAR or WSDL files.
Essentials includes unlimited collection runs and environments and 1,000 mock server requests a month.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Git Sync for up to 3 users, Inso CLI access, 1,000 mock server requests a month

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: The page does not state whether $12 is the annual or the monthly rate. The page shows $ without naming a currency. Adds Git Sync for all users, role-based access and 10,000 mock server requests a month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: The page does not state whether $45 is the annual or the monthly rate. Self-serve up to 50 users, then contact sales. Adds SAML and OIDC single sign-on, SCIM and unlimited mock server requests

hiddenCosts: Mock server requests beyond the included amount cost $10 per 25,000 requests on Essentials and Pro.
